name: Double Knot NYC
summary: Double Knot, from restaurateur Michael Schulson, has been celebrated for bold sushi, sashimi and robatayaki, paired with inventive cocktails and saké.

name: Le Monde
summary: This restaurant in Columbia University’s neighborhood celebrates the cuisine of France's Loire Valley.

name: Rialto Ristorante
summary: Rialto Ristorante is the culmination of restaurateur Milan Licul's storied history in the Italian fine dining space with a nod to modern presentation and palates.

name: BKK New York
summary: With fresh takes on NYC staples, like the BKK Hot Dog with homemade Thai pork sausage, BKK serves innovative spins on NYC dishes, while delivering authentic Thai flavors, and traditional homestyle classics.

name: Wabi Nori - Queens
summary: Wabi Nori Queens is a modern omakase experience featuring artfully prepared hand rolls and signature cocktails, all set within an intimate atmosphere and a beautifully curated menu.

name: SoZo Sip Bar + Omakase
summary: At SoZo Sip Bar + Omakase, each course is thoughtfully prepared using the freshest seasonal ingredients, while their beverage program highlights artisanal sake, rare whiskies, and balanced cocktails.

name: Dhamaka
summary: Located at Essex Market on the Lower East Side of Manhattan, Dhamaka dives deep into the bold, provincial cooking rarely seen outside of Indian homes and roadside stalls.
address: Essex Market, 119 Delancey St., Store #34, Manhattan, NY 10002

name: Masalawala & Sons
summary: Restaurateur Roni Mazumdar and Chintan Pandya explore the yesteryears of India from the perspective of a 75-year-old immigrant man from Kolkata—Roni’s father.

name: Don Don Korean BBQ
summary: Don Don Restaurant by Chef Shim is a distinctive Korean BBQ haven, serving dry-aged pork in a Korean casual street restaurant-style setting.

name: Skinny's Cantina
summary: Skinny's Cantina is the perfect home for celebrations, family and Mexican cuisine with a heart.

name: Fish Cheeks Brooklyn
summary: Fish Cheeks, a New York City institution since opening in NoHo in 2016, brings their vibrant coastal Thai flavors and warm hospitality to Williamsburg.

name: Miss Nellie's
summary: Miss Nellie's is an American restaurant and bar in Hell's Kitchen, on the edge of the Theatre District and Times Square.

name: Bar Chuzo
summary: Bar Chuzo is a Latin bistro and cocktail bar in Bay Ridge, Brooklyn, that specializes in coastal Ecuadorian staples, such as ceviche, chuzos (skewers) as well as paella, oysters and steak.

name: Jade Rabbit
summary: Jade Rabbit is a lush and lively rooftop izakaya and cocktail bar atop the Kimpton Era Midtown New York that features small plates bursting with Asian flavors, along with flavorful riffs on Asian and tiki cocktails.
address: Kimpton Era Hotel, 32 W. 48th St., rooftop, Manhattan, NY 10036

name: Izakaya Futago
summary: Discover playful innovations like Spoon Sushi, a one-bite reimagining of traditional nigiri sushi, alongside freshly-made soba noodles, izakaya dishes, and original cocktails crafted with sake.

name: Bocado Cafe
summary: This rustic-chic restaurant and wine bar on Manhattan's Upper East Side has a welcoming vibe and an easy, all-day rhythm.

name: Yoon Haeundae Galbi
summary: Owner Bobby Yoon started Yoon Haeundae Galbi to carry on his grandfather's legacy and bring authentic Korean food from Haeundae, Busan, South Korea to New York City.

name: DK PubLIC
summary: DK PubLIC is a century-old gastropub in Long Island City where history and charm blend seamlessly with a vibrant atmosphere.

name: Recreation
summary: Recreation, a beloved Financial District cocktail bar that blends playful vintage gaming with the timeless style of Americana, serves expertly crafted cocktails and shareable bites.
address: Moxy NYC Downtown, 26 Ann St., 3rd fl., Manhattan, NY 10038

name: The Kunjip
summary: This beloved Koreatown eatery serves up authentic entrees, casseroles and barbecue.

name: Thep
summary: Thep Thai brings the vibrant flavors and warm hospitality of Bangkok to Manhattan's Upper East Side.

name: Yakiniku Futago
summary: Sleek and dimly lit Yakiniku Futago specializes in Japanese barbecue.

name: Benoit Restaurant & Wine Bar
summary: This Midtown French bistro comes courtesy of Alain Ducasse, arguably the top French chef in the world.

name: Joseph's
summary: The kitchen at Joseph's Restaurant churns out rustic northern Italian dishes reminiscent of the old country.

name: Sake No Hana
summary: This lively, modern Japanese restaurant serves free-spirited izakaya dishes invigorated with New York attitude.
address: Moxy NYC Lower East Side, 145 Bowery, Manhattan, NY 10002

name: Oceans
summary: With a name like Oceans, it’s no surprise to learn that this restaurant’s menu is inspired by fresh catches from the Atlantic, Pacific and Mediterranean.

name: La Voglia
summary: La Voglia is an elegant restaurant offering contemporary interpretations of Italian classics on the Upper East Side.

name: Lafayette
summary: Lafayette, a French restaurant in downtown Manhattan's NoHo neighborhood, is at once a gorgeous dining destination, vibrant nightspot and delectable French bakery.

name: Saar
summary: Enjoy sophisticated Indian fare in the Theatre District.

name: La Pecora Bianca Midtown
summary: La Pecora Bianca Midtown offers a relaxed, all-day dining experience with approachable, quality Italian food, in a stylish and comfortable setting.

name: Grandma's Home
summary: With a goal of warming every guest's stomach and heart, Grandma’s Home offers authentic Hangzhou flavors from the land of fish and rice.

name: Morgan's Brooklyn Barbecue
summary: Morgan's is Brooklyn through and through, a restaurant with a DIY edge that is as mindful of families with young kids as it is of the borough's bearded whiskey fanatics.

name: Sotto la Luna
summary: Sotto la Luna is an open-kitchen pasta bar and Neapolitan pizzeria that serves modern Italian food in a high-ceiling,space.

name: Niku X
summary: Niku X specializes exclusively in authentic Japanese A5 wagyu steak—their signature unlimited prix-fixe menu allows guests to indulge freely—enjoying as much premium wagyu as they desire.

name: Mermaid Inn - Upper West Side
summary: The Mermaid Inn is an American seafood brasserie, replete with style, hospitality and a menu marked by bold and seasonally inspired cuisine.

name: Togyushi
summary: Togyushi blends two experiences: a fine dining omakase counter showcasing traditional techniques, and a more casual wagyu bistro bar and lounge offering small plates, signature cocktails and Japanese vinyl culture.

name: Amasa
summary: Amasa is a contemporary Latin steakhouse, helmed by chef Christopher Loeffl, where bold Latin American flavors meet modern culinary artistry.
address: Kimpton Era Hotel, 32 W 48th St., ground fl., Manhattan, NY 10036

name: Viv
summary: Viv is a design-forward Thai restaurant and cocktail bar in Hell’s Kitchen with a lively nightlife scene in later hours.
8282 is a light-hearted, fresh take on Korean food on the Lower East Side.

name: Mito - Fort Greene
summary: Mito's esteemed head chef, who has devoted numerous years to the masterful art of cooking, brings with him a wealth of experience at esteemed establishments such as Jean Georges and Buddha Bar.

name: Frida Midtown
summary: Frida Midtown is a Latin Fusion restaurant offering a creative menu of Mexican-Peruvian cuisine.

name: Le District Bar & Bistro
summary: Enjoy an extensive menu designed to satisfy every palate or unwind with a well-deserved cocktail at Le District Bar & Bistro, the perfect spot to take in the waterfront, offering views of historic Ellis Island.

name: Veeray da Dhaba
summary: Founded by Michelin-starred chef Hemant Mathur, Veeray Da Dhaba brings Punjabi food to the East Village, celebrating slow-cooked classics, vibrant spices and the warm hospitality of Punjabi culture.

name: Arvine
summary: Arvine is a modern, urban and relaxed restaurant that offers approachable, yet elegant European-influenced American cuisine and drinks in Manhattan's West Village.

name: San Pietro Ristorante
summary: Family owned and operated since 1992, San Pietro is a landmark Midtown Manhattan destination celebrating the authentic culinary traditions of Salerno and the Amalfi Coast.

name: Masaaki
summary: At Masaaki in Bayside, Queens, find go-to sushi rolls and hibachi, as well as delicately prepared 19-course omakase.

name: Fogo de Chão Brazilian Steakhouse - World Trade Center
summary: Fogo de Chão's seventh New York restaurant, located at Westfield World Trade Center, features an open churrasco grill where guests can dine and watch gaucho chefs demonstrate the culinary art of churrasco.

name: Anassa Taverna - Astoria
summary: Set in Astoria, Queens, Anassa is an elegant interpretation of the traditional Greek taverna.

name: Amélie - West Village
summary: At this Greenwich Village location, the intention is to make good wine accessible, affordable and fun.

name: Bustan
summary: Bustan blossoms with a contemporary pan-Mediterranean vibe that extends the shores of Southern Europe, Western Asian and North Africa to Manhattan's Upper West Side.

name: La Piazza
summary: La Piazza New York is an elegant Italian restaurant in Midtown Manhattan that channels two decades of Venetian culinary tradition into New York City.

name: Olio e Più East Village
summary: Olio e Più's third New York City location brings Italian warmth, energy, and lively trattoria spirit to the East Village, a neighborhood that lives and breathes culture.

name: Tinos
summary: Named after the picturesque Greek island known for its rich culture and stunning views, Tinos combines the charm of the Mediterranean with the taste of time-honored recipes.

name: City Vineyard
summary: Offering year-round riverfront dining, live music, extraordinary views, and an elevated culinary experience, City Vineyard is the culinary outpost by City Winery.

name: ABC Kitchens DUMBO
summary: ABC Kitchens’ seasonally driven menu is an evolution and combination of Jean-Georges' Manhattan restaurants, ABC Kitchen, abcV and ABC Cocina, under one roof on the DUMBO waterfront.

name: Ramerino Italian Prime
summary: Ramerino Italian Prime combines traditional Italian culinary heritage with a modern fine-dining atmosphere.

name: Bar Rocco
summary: Bar Rocco is an Italian American brasserie from James Beard Award-winning chef Rocco DiSpirito, its name a playful nod to both the chef himself and the restaurant's iconic location beside Rockefeller Plaza.
address: Kimpton Era Hotel, 32 W. 48th St., 2nd fl., Manhattan, NY 10036

name: YongChuan
summary: Yong Chuan NYC offers a modern take on Ningbo and Eastern Chinese cuisine on Manhattan's Lower East Side.

name: Ishq
summary: The menu at this East Village restaurant is a celebration of India's culinary treasures—from aromatic curries to flavorful tandoori offerings, all made with the finest spices and ingredients.

name: Haidilao Huoguo
summary: This reliable hot pot chain restaurant is open all day and night.

name: Amélie - Upper West Side
summary: "La Petite Amélie" is smaller and more intimate than Amélie's other locations, but has the same look and vibe.

name: Yakiniku Gen - Midtown
summary: Yakiniku Gen offers a truly authentic Japanese BBQ dining experience with more than 70 branches in Japan and five in NYC.

name: Kimmi
summary: TLK-Tigerlily Kitchen is back with an exciting new chapter: Kimmi, a new dine-in concept on Canal Street in Chinatown, where Asian fusion flavors meet a beautifully designed atmosphere.

name: Florentin Bistro
summary: This chic Neo-American bistro and bar on the Upper West Side serves seasonal, Mediterranean-inspired cuisine with influences from French, Italian, Greek, Israeli and Middle Eastern cooking.

name: Miru
summary: Perched atop Pier 57 in Chelsea, Miru is a rooftop Japanese listening lounge, rooftop bar and dining destination that offers a tranquil escape by day and a sultry, immersive atmosphere by night.
address: Pier 57 at Hudson River Park, 25 Eleventh Ave., New York, NY 10011

name: Lalyn
summary: Lalyn is a modern Thai restaurant in Manhattan's Garment District that's known for authentic Thai food with a refined touch and Thai-inspired cocktails, wine and craft beverages.

name: Benihana
summary: Benihana is a dining experience unlike any other: guests are seated at communal tables in groups, where a personal chef will perform the ancient art of teppanyaki.

name: SaiTong Thai
summary: SaiTong, an upscale Thai restaurant located in the Theatre District in Midtown Manhattan, offers an authentic modern Thai dining experience in an elegant, wood-accented atmosphere

name: Caravaggio
summary: Located on Manhattan's Upper East Side, Caravaggio boasts elegant Italian cuisine with a modern twist.

name: Anassa Taverna - Downtown
summary: Nestled in Battery Park City, Anassa is an elegant interpretation of the traditional Greek taverna.

name: Code Red Restaurant & Lounge
summary: Code Red Restaurant & Lounge is a dynamic and innovative Caribbean restaurant and bar located in the Laconia neighborhood in The Bronx.
address: 1320 E. Gun Hill Rd., Bronx, NY 10469

name: Quality Meats
summary: A property of the venerable Smith & Wollensky steakhouse overlords, this stylish restaurant is the domain of chef Craig Koketsu and the storied meats of purveyors Milton Abeles and Strassburger Meats.

name: Hanaya Omakase
summary: Chef Yousi Chen serves a 13-course Omakase at his Chef's Counter with an à la carte menu as well.

name: Chatti by Regi Mathew
summary: Chatti by Regi Mathew is New York City's first restaurant entirely dedicated to the toddy shops of Kerala, India.

name: Yasouvlaki West
summary: Yasouvlaki is a lively Greek restaurant that brings the flavors and spirit of Greece to a casual dining experience on Manhattan's Upper West Side.

name: Felice Flatiron
summary: Located on a prominent corner in Manhattan’s Flatiron District, the restaurant marks a natural evolution of Felice: a space grounded in Tuscan heritage and designed to feel embedded within the neighborhood.
